servers._comment: Server A. Clients 1 and 2 offer the same two ciphers in opposite orders and BOTH receive ECDHE; client 3 offers only CBC and receives it, proving CBC is supported. Both facts together make server_order identifiable.
Server B. Client 1 offers [ECDHE, CBC] and gets ECDHE; client 2 offers [CBC, ECDHE] and gets CBC. Each receives its own first choice, which only client_order explains.

Server C, TLS 1.3 only. Sessions s13-s15 fail with no common version and contribute nothing. Clients 4 and 6 offer the two TLS 1.3 suites in opposite orders and both receive AES_128; client 5 offers only AES_256 and receives it. TLS 1.2 is NOT excluded here: exclusion requires a client to offer a version ABOVE the one negotiated.
